description: Defines the QuicChaosProtector class responsible for chaos protection in QUIC protocol, including methods for building data packets with padding, splitting crypto frames, adding ping frames, and reordering frames.

classes.name: quic::QuicChaosProtector
classes.description: Class responsible for chaos protection in QUIC, including packet building, crypto data handling, frame manipulation, and padding.

methods.name: QuicChaosProtector
methods.description: Constructor initializing chaos protector with crypto frame, padding, packet size, framer, and random generator.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Attempts to build a chaos-protected data packet, returning serialized length or nullopt on error.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Writes stream data, overriding base class method.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data, overriding base class method.

methods.name: CopyCryptoDataToLocalBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffer and copies crypto data into it.

methods.name: SplitCryptoFrame
methods.description: Splits crypto frames into multiple frames, adjusting padding.

methods.name: AddPingFrames
methods.description: Adds random ping frames to frames list and adjusts padding.

methods.name: SpreadPadding
methods.description: Adds padding frames randomly between other frames.

methods.name: BuildPacket
methods.description: Serializes frames into a packet buffer using framer.
